validation_provenance.method: Independent semantic derivation of all eight dimensions and every required-fact status from the neutral rubric, question, evidence and answer; supplied labels compared only to derived verdicts. Structural checks independently verify evidence/source/citation identity and exact content, excerpt fidelity, numeric-ID uniqueness, answer identity, fact-status keys, and freeze/brief hashes.
validation_provenance.isolation: Procedural separation in a shared workspace; only the four declared files were read. No evaluator/runtime code, old cases/results, roadmap, AGENTS files, Git operations, other agent outputs, network or external APIs used. Visible freeze hash inventory was not followed to referenced files.
validation_provenance.limitations: Agent review, not expert human adjudication, security isolation, independent production validation or an application runtime holdout. Freshness relative to earlier suites and actual frozen code contents cannot be verified under the read restriction.
